fields.before:
Goat milk soap gives a creamy lather that leaves skin feeling soft rather than tight. Vilvah makes these bars with goat milk and plant oils such as olive, coconut and castor oil, and Swansura is the brand’s official UK partner.

The bars

Classic Goat Milk Soap (£9.99) is lightly scented with lavender essential oil, Classic Rose Goat Milk Soap (£9.99) adds rose petals and French pink clay, and Charcoal Goat Milk Soap (£9.99) pairs activated charcoal with goat milk. Cucumber, Curd & Mint Soap (£9.99) has a fresh, minty scent.

How to use

Lather between wet hands, massage over damp skin and rinse well. Keep the bar on a draining soap dish so it lasts, and follow with a body lotion if your skin tends to feel dry. Patch test before first use.

See the whole goat milk range or skincare gift sets. UK delivery is free on orders over £40.

fields.before:
Goat milk soap is just the start of this range. These 21 creamy, gentle products from Vilvah, Deyga and Swansura Selection use goat, oat, soy and almond milk for face, body and hair, with prices from £9.99. Swansura is an official UK partner of Vilvah and Deyga, and every order ships from the UK.

Face

Vilvah Milk Powder Face Wash is a water-free milk face wash with hyaluronic acid, made for normal to oily skin, at £13.99. Deyga Oat Milk Face Wash is an oat milk face wash for dry or sensitive skin. If you were searching for a goat milk face wash, these two are the closest gentle cleansers in our range. Follow with Vilvah Milk Face Toner, Milk Drops Hydrating Serum and Milk Mud Mask, or buy them together in the Milk Face Kit. Our Milk Glow Routine shows how they fit together.

Body

Swansura Selection makes three goat milk soap bars at £9.99: Classic Goatmilk, Classic Rose and Charcoal Goatmilk. Vilvah Goat Milk Body Wash adds goat milk and virgin coconut oil, and Vilvah Milk Body Lotion uses oat milk, ceramides and olive squalane. Deyga Almond Milk Body Lotion is a lighter choice. The Milk Body Kit pairs wash and lotion.

Hair

Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo is a goat milk shampoo that cleanses without stripping, and Vilvah Goat Milk Hair Mask uses goat milk and ceramides to soften dry hair. Deyga Soy Milk Conditioner restores softness to rough lengths. The Goat Milk Hair Kit puts the set together. See more in Haircare or deep hydration. Free UK delivery applies over £40.

fields.before:
The best stocking fillers are small things she will actually use: a mini of a perfume she loves, a lip balm for her coat pocket, a good soap. Everything in this guide costs under £25, is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, so you can fill a whole stocking from one order. For the full range, see our stocking fillers and gifts under £25.

Designer perfume minis

A miniature is a lovely way to give a designer scent on a small budget, and it fits in a handbag afterwards.

  • Gucci Bloom Parfum 10ml (£19.99): the richest Bloom, with tuberose and jasmine over vanilla and Peru balsam.
  • Calvin Klein My Euphoria 10ml (£18.99): blackcurrant, orchid and rose over vanilla and amber, sweet and warm.
  • Marc Jacobs Daisy Love 10ml (£19.99): cloudberry and daisy over cashmere musk, light and cheerful for daytime.
  • Viktor & Rolf Good Fortune 10ml (£19.99): fennel and jasmine over bourbon vanilla.
  • Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever 4.5ml (£14.99) and Trussardi Pure Jasmine 7ml (£14.99): the smallest budgets, still in a proper bottle.
  • Hermès Un Jardin sur le Toit 15ml (£24.99): apple, pear and rose with a green grass accord.

If she likes to try a few, the Korloff Paris Discovery Set (3 x 10ml) (£19.99) holds three scents in one box. More in travel size and mini perfumes.

Lip balms and lip scrubs

Lip care is the classic stocking filler: cheap, useful and welcome in winter.

  • Vilvah Grapefruit Lip Balm (£6.99): shea butter, avocado and almond oils with a sheer tint and a zesty scent.
  • Vilvah Milk Lip Balm SPF 30 PA+++ (£9.99): mineral filters with shea, soy and kokum butters, for winter walks and ski trips.
  • Deyga Natural Lip Balm (£9.99): almond oil, jojoba and shea butter, in vanilla or shea.
  • Vilvah Lip Scrub (£6.99) or Deyga Strawberry Lip Scrub (£10.99): sugar in plant oils and butter to buff away dry flakes.
  • Ready-made pairs: Vilvah Lip Nourishing Kit (£13.99), a lip scrub and grapefruit balm, and Deyga Soft Lip Combo (£17.99), a mint lip scrub and beetroot balm.

Our lip scrub guide explains how to use them, and every balm and scrub is in lip balm and lip care.

Goat milk soaps and bath bars

A handmade soap looks generous wrapped in tissue and costs very little. The Vilvah bars are made with farm-fresh goat milk: Classic Rose Goat Milk Soap (£9.99) with rose petals and pink clay, Classic Goat Milk Soap (£9.99) with lavender essential oil, and Cucumber, Curd & Mint Soap (£9.99) for a fresh morning shower. See all four in goat milk soap. From Deyga, the Shea Saffron Bath Bar (£15.99) and Rose Pink Clay Bath Bar (£14.99) are made with raw shea butter and coconut and olive oils.

Small pamper gifts

  • Vilvah Wild Rose Face Mask (£11.99): three ingredients, aloe vera, French pink clay and rose hydrosol, for a 15-minute Sunday mask.
  • Deyga Foot Butter (£12.99): coconut oil, olive oil and beeswax with a soft vanilla scent, for feet after a long day in boots.
  • anatomē Chamomile Bath Salts (from £24): natural salts with organic botanicals for a slow evening bath, in a refill pouch or a jar.
  • Vilvah Deo Shot Kit (£17.99): two pocket-size solid deodorants, Rose & Vanilla and Lavender & Sage.

How to fill a stocking for around £50

One perfume mini, one lip balm, one lip scrub and a soap comes to about £43 to £51 with the picks above. That also takes the order over £40, so UK delivery is free. For bigger gifts, read our perfume gift sets guide or the Christmas gift guide.

Good to know

  • Patch test new skincare before first use, especially products with essential oils.
  • Every product is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK. Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga and Vilvah.
  • UK delivery is free on orders over £40, and orders over £70 get £5 off at checkout.
